non-blocking: lattice_vertex_groups documents that 'A merge is accepted only where the match is mutual and unique', but the body at :377-407 joins every pair within reach with no mutuality or uniqueness test; the only rejection implemented is the group-spread check at :399-406.

non-blocking: the determinism arm compares two solves of the unchanged code at 1 and 4 BLAS threads, and no recorded measurement shows it reddening if ordered_solve is replaced by np.linalg.solve; a 12-unknown dense dgesv is commonly bit-identical across thread counts, so the assertion states the done_when's test but cannot be shown to fail on the regression it is named to guard, leaving the deterministic-solve half of the change without a falsified guard.
